description.value: Original Tandoori Kitchen is a full-service Indian restaurant on Main Street in Vancouver's South Vancouver neighbourhood, specialising in tandoori meats, fresh-baked breads, and regional curries prepared by named chefs using traditional techniques. The restaurant presents itself as a fine-dining experience while offering an extensive menu that spans hearty biryanis, seekh kebabs, and a wide range of vegetarian dishes. Touring cyclists will find a sit-down dining room with table reservations available online.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact fields: phone (604) 327-8900, address 7215 Main Street Vancouver V5X 3J3, and business name. The menu pages document multiple explicitly vegetarian dishes (Vegetable Samosa, Gobhi Pakora, Paneer Pakora, Paneer Tikka, Vegetable Biryani), confirming a vegetarian option. An 'Order Now' button and online ordering flow confirm takeout availability; no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Footer text on the About and Contact pages reads 'Original Tandoor Kitchen' (missing the 'i' in Tandoori), a minor name inconsistency with the OSM name and page title; not a substantive concern but worth noting.
No bike parking, water refill, or washroom evidence found on the website or in OSM tags — key WWC required criteria are all unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active sit-down restaurant with a hearty menu well-suited to refuelling cyclists; the online ordering option also suits takeout needs. No cycling-specific infrastructure is confirmed, but as a Food & Drink listing it meets the baseline threshold for directory inclusion.
